summary: Cloudflare's Workers AI includes a free allocation of 10,000 Neurons per day for anyone - enough for thousands of small LLM or image generations. It runs on Cloudflare's edge network with an OpenAI-compatible REST interface and resets daily at 00:00 UTC.
claim_steps: Create a free Cloudflare account and open the dashboard.
Navigate to the Workers AI section and accept the terms.
Create a Workers AI API token, or add the AI binding inside any Worker.
Run models via REST or Worker bindings within the daily 10,000-Neuron free allowance.

social_proof.title: Pricing · Cloudflare Workers AI docs
social_proof.text: Workers AI pricing is based on Neurons, with a free daily allocation and per-model rates.
